definition: The Content → Content map neg is a syntactic/expression operation. ConflictingOpinions requires opinions of p and neg p. NegationRespected is a separate interpretive premise: truth of neg p entails nontruth of p under one predicate. The contradiction test needs that bridge; spelling an expression as negation does not prove it.
note: A minimal stipulated test semantics for #207, not a translation of every historical or modern use. A sourced defense and a translation from ordinary truth claims remain research obligations.
